name: Hilary A. Sefton
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Naperville, Illinois
about: Hilary A. Sefton is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027. She works at Sefton Kelly Family Law, located in Naperville, Illinois, and provides legal services for issues involving Family Law to the surrounding community.
Hilary Sefton completed legal studies at The John Marshall Law School and graduated with the class of 2007. Hilary Sefton passed the bar in 2007.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
